manifest:
[package]
name="combined-proof"
version="0.0.0"
edition="2021"
[dependencies]
baseline={package="meshoptimizer-baseline",path="<target>/base",default-features=false,features=["clusterlod"]}
candidate={package="meshoptimizer-rs",path="<worktree>",default-features=false,features=["clusterlod"]}
meshopt="=0.7.0"
[[bin]]
name="remap"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-remap/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="spatial"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-spatial/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="repair"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-repair/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="simplify"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-simplify/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="decode"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-decode/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="bounds"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-bounds/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="vdecode"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-vdecode/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="stream"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-stream/exact.rs"
[[bin]]
name="remap_cpp"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-remap/cpp-differential.rs"
[[bin]]
name="repair_corpus"
path="<worktree>/parity/0216-repair/corpus.rs"
[[bin]]
name="geometry"
path="<worktree>/parity/0215-toward-cpp/geometry-exact.rs"
[profile.release]
lto="thin"
codegen-units=1
debug-assertions=true
overflow-checks=true
